node.title: Conductor-256 character eigenvalue preflight
node.closure: directed interval arithmetic and exact finite dynamic programming
node.statement: All 63 nontrivial character eigenvalues of the conductor-256 unit-log convolution have certified outward intervals. On the universal prize envelope every exponent vector satisfies max |xi_t|<=7 and sum xi_t^2<=101, but the coarse zero-sum body has more than 2^143 points and the weighted ellipsoid contains at least 38482585013041 explicit sparse points. Generic ellipsoid-first enumeration is therefore rejected in favor of sparse-product/inverse classification.
node.notes: CERTIFIED PREFLIGHT AND ROUTE CUT 2026-07-29: Machin/Taylor/atanh directed arithmetic gives spectrum digest 6ee33c37477a58c92a087cd7dcf3c128d148a2c8d08887141ff79367aa9efb8d, min magnitude >1.7627, max <24.292, D<7.539, and R<77.202.
